request: User requested an additional learning-rate schedule experiment during the constant LR x3 full-short run.
name: adamw-lr3-cosine200
single_change: Replace the post-warmup constant rate with cosine decay to half the peak over 200 actual training epochs after warmup.
schedule_definition: At issued update u, use the original completed-update linear warmup for u <= 50. Afterwards let e=actual_epochs(u)-actual_epochs(50), x=min(e/200,1), and rate=3*task_rate*(0.5+0.25*(1+cos(pi*x))). Include short-tail batches in actual_epochs. Keep rate at 1.5*task_rate after decay; no restarts or resets.
hypothesis: Keep the larger early steps while lowering the later rate, which may reduce short-suite overshoot without losing all of the early progress. This is a hypothesis to test, not an assumed improvement.
screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
parent_comparison: Also report ratios versus constant LR x3 to isolate the schedule change.
full_suite_policy: If the screen qualifies, evaluate all 75 short cells. Select among complete configurations using coverage then full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Never compute a screened or censored filtered aggregate.
long_policy: Defer the round-2 long check until this additional short experiment is resolved. Check only the final short winner once, at original budgets; explicitly label the previously observed long suite as a reused regression diagnostic.
provenance_policy: Finish and preserve constant LR x3 before extending the schedule factory. Keep its source archive immutable and use its pinned source revision if its long diagnostic is later needed.
invariants: Unchanged frozen model sources, task manifest, data, seeds, batch order, dimensions, dtype, warmup, weight decay, evaluation cadence and update budgets; separately archived code/configuration for every new output directory.
